$comment: Indexes required by CreateCVOnline. Deploy with `npm run firebase:rules`. Firestore auto-creates single-field indexes at COLLECTION scope only, so single-field COLLECTION_GROUP lookups must be declared under `fieldOverrides` — declaring them under `indexes` is rejected with HTTP 400 'this index is not necessary'. A fieldOverride REPLACES the automatic config for that field, so the COLLECTION-scoped entries below are re-declared on purpose, not redundantly.

indexes.$comment: getSharedCV(): collection-group lookup of a public CV by its share id. Two equality filters, so a real composite index.

fieldOverrides.$comment: listAllCVs(): admin feed of most-recently-edited CVs across every account. COLLECTION entries keep listCVs() working inside a single user's subcollection.
listAllPayments(): admin payment ledger across every account. COLLECTION entries keep listUserPayments() working.
revenueSummary(): equality filter on status across every account, no ordering.
